name: MLCommons MLPerf Inference Benchmark
description: MLCommons MLPerf Inference Benchmark is a standardized benchmark suite for measuring the inference performance of machine learning systems across a range of representative workloads. It evaluates how quickly and efficiently hardware/software stacks can serve trained models under defined accuracy constraints, and is used to compare systems on throughput, latency, and efficiency for different deployment scenarios.
evaluation_method: performance benchmarking using throughput, latency, and accuracy-constrained results on standardized inference workloads
general_score_metric: queries per second / samples per second at target accuracy and latency
typical_sota_score: varies widely by workload and system; top results are generally reported as benchmark-leading throughput under accuracy constraints rather than a single universal score
notes: This is a suite benchmark rather than a single task. Results depend on the model, precision mode, hardware platform, and the specific inference scenario (e.g., offline, server, edge).
